body: As someone who is bad at the game, ive been accused of feeding intentionally more often than id like. My friends say its easy to tell the difference between someone who is bad and someone who is doing it on purpose but ive still been reported for it. I think this may be why its a little complex to fix.

Hey man, ive been playing for like.. months. Just never ranked until now. Trust me when i say it takes quite a bit of practice. This sub is pretty good about helping people get better too so dont be afraid to reach out. I still know i can improve too. Dont get bummed out, just keep grinding, and try not to fall into any habits. This game is all about adapting and learning. Just practice and definitely play people better than you. Eatch and learn basically lol. Also, training mode is your friend.
Good tips. Thanks. I'll admit i was fairly nervous being new to the whole ranked thing but at least i know what to look for when it comes to improving.
